parsed.explanation: The parent layer imposes real traveler-facing exposures: visa officers instructed to scrutinize and potentially permanently bar applicants for suspected 'misrepresentation' of sex; documented abuse of trans people in immigration custody; passport-marker restrictions (resident-facing, but signals institutional hostility); facility bans across many subunits; and state-level hostility framing trans people as threats. Several measures are enjoined or contested, and national hate-crime and marriage machinery still operates, partially mediating. The division adds a tier-1 custody exposure: birth-sex placement with a documented sexual assault dismissed as 'de minimis' by its own courts — an unremedied institutional harm, though it reaches only visitors who enter detention. There is no local facility criminal statute, no documented campaign of police arrests for presentation, and no violence data; the under-19 care ban and surgery-based marker rules are resident-facing. Marriage/adoption recognition and national housing/employment coverage are climate positives. This resembles 0.45-C/D: hostile institutional rules and an unremedied custody practice without criminalisation or organised targeting. 0.42.
